dedupe_keys.name: natural earth roads and railroads 1 10m cultural vectors

description: Natural Earth is a public-domain map dataset at 1:10m, 1:50m and 1:110m scales, made by Tom Patterson, Nathaniel Vaughn Kelso and contributors. Its 10m cultural vectors include roads and railroads. Coverage: a global roads layer (ne_10m_roads), plus North America supplements: roads from the XNR Productions database at 1:1,000,000 (usable to 1:250,000) for the United States, Canada, Mexico and Belize, with federal, state and provincial classes, divided-road flags and ferries, and 'basic' railroads from the CEC North America Environmental Atlas without attributes and with 20 m positional accuracy. Format and access: zipped shapefiles, version 4.0.0. Licence and cost: all Natural Earth raster and vector data are in the public domain per its terms of use; no permission or credit is required. Caveats: small-scale cartographic data, not an engineering network; the roads page also cites the Global Roads Inventory Project, and a user comment reports a truncated railroads download. The layers can be used as coarse inputs for continental network flow models and as base maps. It relates to GRIP4 and OpenStreetMap in the catalogue.
